choice_policy: Teaching ranges, not installed-API defaults or measured hardware-safe maxima. Not all optional theory controls belong in the first runnable lab.

parameters.label: Training fraction
parameters.definition: Fraction of eligible training/development records assigned to fitting; the reserved final test is excluded.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: n_train≈fraction×eligible independent units; rounding/group rules are explicit.
parameters.expected_effect: More fitting data leaves less development evidence; it is not free extra data.
failure_modes: Never split related records across independence boundaries merely to achieve an exact fraction.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.definition: Initializes declared random generators for splitting, initialization or sampling.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Seed→pseudo-random sequence under recorded software/backend.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes one realization; repeating seeds measures variation, not increasing quality.
interactions: independent split seed versus model seed
failure_modes: A seed is not a cross-platform bitwise guarantee.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Numeric scaling
parameters.definition: Train-fitted transformation of feature units.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Standard: (x−training_mean)/training_std.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes distances, penalties and optimization scale; trees generally need no order-preserving standardization.
failure_modes: Fitting on all data leaks holdout information; centring sparse text can exhaust memory.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Missing-value handling
parameters.definition: Policy for absent numeric measurements, fitted on training data.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Replace absent x_j with fitted median_j; optional indicator records absence.
parameters.expected_effect: Avoids invalid inputs but can erase or encode informative missingness.
failure_modes: Missingness is not a measured zero and cannot be imputed with future data.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Feature encoding
parameters.definition: Maps categorical/text values to model-compatible features.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: One-hot: category→indicator vector; TF-IDF combines term frequency and train-fitted document rarity.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes represented information, sparsity and feature dimension.
failure_modes: Only show encodings compatible with the selected input type.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Text n-grams
parameters.definition: Lengths of consecutive token sequences included as text features.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Unigram counts individual terms; bigrams include adjacent pairs.
parameters.expected_effect: Bigrams can capture short order patterns while increasing feature count and sparsity.
failure_modes: Fit vocabulary inside training folds; rare phrases can memorize source identity.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Vocabulary limit
parameters.definition: Maximum retained training-derived text features.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Matrix shape [cases,retained_vocabulary].
parameters.expected_effect: More features retain detail but increase memory and selection variance.
failure_modes: The limit is not a promise that every dataset contains that many distinct features.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Fit intercept
parameters.definition: Learn a constant offset in addition to feature coefficients.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: prediction=x·w+b when enabled.
parameters.expected_effect: Supports nonzero baselines; disabling imposes an origin constraint.
failure_modes: Do not duplicate an intercept and an included polynomial constant without a defined convention.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Solver tolerance
parameters.definition: Numerical stopping criterion of the selected solver.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Exact residual/change rule is solver-specific.
parameters.expected_effect: Tighter tolerances may take longer; they do not directly regularize data fitting.
failure_modes: A converged solver can still fit the wrong objective or overfit.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Solver iteration limit
parameters.definition: Maximum solver iterations, not neural training epochs.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Count depends on algorithm implementation.
parameters.expected_effect: Higher caps allow more optimization but consume time; inspect convergence warnings.
failure_modes: Do not fabricate per-epoch traces for a solver exposing only a final fit.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Inverse regularization C
parameters.definition: Estimator-specific inverse regularization scale.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: For common conventions, larger C weakens relative regularization; exact objective scaling differs.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger C can fit training violations more aggressively and increase overfitting.
failure_modes: C is not interchangeable with ridge alpha or lambda across sample counts/libraries.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Decision threshold
parameters.definition: Cutoff converting a positive-class probability/score into a decision.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Predict positive if p≥threshold under the declared score convention.
parameters.expected_effect: Lower probability thresholds generally increase positive decisions, trading recall against precision.
failure_modes: Select on development data, not test; probability and raw-score thresholds differ.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Class weighting
parameters.definition: Relative fitting weight assigned to labels.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: A weighted objective scales each sample/class contribution; reduction semantics vary.
parameters.expected_effect: Emphasizes selected classes but can change calibration and false alarms.
failure_modes: Do not silently apply both resampling and weighting as if they were one treatment.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Penalty strength
parameters.definition: Weight of a declared coefficient penalty.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Teaching convention: mean_loss+lambda||w||²/2 for L2.
parameters.expected_effect: Higher values shrink coefficients more; too much can underfit.
failure_modes: Validate API normalization before converting this control to an estimator parameter.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: L1 share
parameters.definition: Mix between L2-like and L1-like regularization under a declared objective.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: rho=0 uses the L2 term; rho=1 uses the L1 term.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes sparsity and shrinkage behaviour, not just overall strength.
failure_modes: A zero coefficient is predictive selection, not proof of causal irrelevance.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Polynomial feature degree
parameters.definition: Maximum degree of constructed feature products.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Including constant: feature count=binomial(d+degree,degree).
parameters.expected_effect: Higher degrees represent nonlinearities and rapidly expand dimensionality.
failure_modes: Cap generated features before allocating large arrays.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Validation folds
parameters.definition: Number of folds under a declared valid splitter.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Each candidate needs one fit per fold plus a possible refit.
parameters.expected_effect: More folds change fit cost and training/evaluation sample sizes, not independent datasets.
failure_modes: Do not apply shuffled K-fold to a temporal or repeated-person claim.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Number of neighbours
parameters.definition: Count of training neighbours contributing to a prediction.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Vote/average over the selected k distances.
parameters.expected_effect: Small k is local/noisy; larger k smooths and can hide small classes.
failure_modes: Require k≤available training cases in every fold.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Neighbour weighting
parameters.definition: How neighbour votes or values are combined.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Uniform mean versus normalized distance-based weights.
parameters.expected_effect: Closer cases can dominate under distance weighting.
failure_modes: Define zero-distance behaviour; naive 1/d at d=0 is invalid.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Minkowski distance power
parameters.definition: Geometry used to compare feature vectors.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: (sum_j |x_j−z_j|^p)^(1/p): p=1 Manhattan, p=2 Euclidean.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes neighbourhood ordering and sensitivity to coordinate differences.
failure_modes: Numeric category codes do not automatically justify metric distances.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Kernel function
parameters.definition: Similarity function corresponding to an implicit feature representation.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Linear: x·z; RBF: exp(−gamma||x−z||²).
parameters.expected_effect: RBF can fit curved boundaries at extra fit/storage cost.
failure_modes: Not every arbitrary similarity matrix is a valid positive-semidefinite kernel.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: RBF locality gamma
parameters.definition: Controls how fast similarity decays with squared distance.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: K(x,z)=exp(−gamma||x−z||²).
parameters.expected_effect: Higher gamma makes influence more local and can create brittle boundaries.
failure_modes: Auto/scale conventions are versioned recipes, not equal to one fixed numeric gamma.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Count smoothing
parameters.definition: Adds positive pseudocounts to categorical/count likelihood estimates.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: P(term|c)=(count+alpha)/(class_total+alpha×vocabulary).
parameters.expected_effect: Larger smoothing weakens rare-event evidence and avoids zero estimates.
failure_modes: Do not apply a count likelihood to arbitrary negative standardized inputs.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Variance stabilizer
parameters.definition: Adds implementation-defined variance stabilization to Gaussian estimates.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: A small positive quantity is added to estimated variances.
parameters.expected_effect: Can reduce division by tiny variance while changing fitted likelihoods.
failure_modes: It is not the same units/control as multinomial pseudocount smoothing.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Maximum tree depth
parameters.definition: Limits successive splits on a path; null means no explicit depth cap.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Depth controls partition nesting, not an exact leaf count for an arbitrary tree.
parameters.expected_effect: Deeper trees fit more local patterns and may overfit.
failure_modes: An unlimited tree can consume substantial memory or isolate individual cases.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Minimum leaf population
parameters.definition: Minimum training cases required in a terminal region.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Eligible split must leave at least this many cases in each child.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger leaves smooth predictions and can miss small subgroups.
failure_modes: Population fractions and integer counts have different API semantics.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Minimum split population
parameters.definition: Minimum cases required to attempt splitting an internal node.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: A node can split only when its population meets the threshold and other constraints.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger values restrict growth; leaf constraints still apply separately.
failure_modes: This is not a minimum population of every final leaf.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Features considered per split
parameters.definition: Subsets candidate features for each randomized split.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: sqrt uses about square-root of feature count, under the estimator's convention.
parameters.expected_effect: Fewer candidates can decorrelate trees but weaken individual splits.
failure_modes: Do not expect smaller feature subsets to help every dataset.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Split criterion
parameters.definition: Measures node label mixing for selecting a split.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Gini=1−sum p_c²; entropy=−sum p_c log p_c.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes the training split preference, not final evaluation metric.
failure_modes: Regression trees require a compatible regression criterion instead.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Number of forest trees
parameters.definition: How many randomized trees are combined.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Forest prediction aggregates M component predictions.
parameters.expected_effect: More trees reduce sampling noise of the ensemble and add compute/storage.
failure_modes: More trees do not correct leakage or create new independent training cases.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Bootstrap training rows
parameters.definition: Whether each tree uses a with-replacement training-row sample.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Repeated indices are allowed inside a bootstrap sample.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes tree diversity and whether out-of-bag estimates are meaningful.
failure_modes: Row bootstrapping is not necessarily valid uncertainty resampling for grouped data.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Boosting learning rate
parameters.definition: Shrinkage applied to each fitted additive correction.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: F_m=F_(m−1)+eta h_m.
parameters.expected_effect: Smaller rate often needs more rounds; larger rate can fit quickly and overfit.
failure_modes: It is not a neural optimizer step size despite the shared name.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Boosting rounds
parameters.definition: Maximum sequential corrections fitted.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: M counts additive learners or iteration stages under the backend.
parameters.expected_effect: More rounds change quality and cost; inspect held-out stopping evidence.
failure_modes: A multiclass backend can fit more than one tree per nominal round.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Boosting row fraction
parameters.definition: Fraction of training rows used for a correction under a supported algorithm.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: n_sample≈fraction×training rows per stage.
parameters.expected_effect: Can add randomness and reduce work but change variance and convergence.
failure_modes: Disable for backends that do not expose this operation; do not silently ignore it.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Maximum boosting leaves
parameters.definition: Limits terminal regions of a base learner.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: More leaves permit finer partitions in one stage.
parameters.expected_effect: Raises per-stage capacity/cost and can overfit small data.
failure_modes: Leaf count is not the same constraint as maximum depth.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Development-based stopping
parameters.definition: Stop or select training duration using a declared development metric.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Record minimum improvement, evaluation cadence and retained checkpoint.
parameters.expected_effect: Can avoid wasted work or overfitting but adds selection decisions.
failure_modes: A backend's hidden internal random split can violate a temporal/group protocol.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Miscoverage target
parameters.definition: Allowed marginal error rate for a declared conformal set/interval.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Coverage target 1−alpha under exchangeability and the specified finite-sample quantile.
parameters.expected_effect: Smaller alpha generally widens sets/intervals.
failure_modes: Not a guarantee of every-subgroup coverage or validity under arbitrary shift.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Bootstrap repetitions
parameters.definition: Resampled metric differences used for a numerical interval estimate.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Recompute full paired metric on each resampled independent unit set.
parameters.expected_effect: More repeats reduce Monte Carlo noise, not bias from the wrong unit.
failure_modes: Never resample only the one final score or pretend repeats are new test cases.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Number of clusters
parameters.definition: Requested centroid/component count.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: k constrains model capacity/group count.
parameters.expected_effect: More groups reduce some fitting objectives but need not improve usefulness.
failure_modes: A returned k-group solution does not prove k natural categories exist.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Cluster restarts
parameters.definition: Independent initial fits before selecting the declared training criterion.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Fit candidates from multiple starts; retain a specified objective optimum.
parameters.expected_effect: Reduces bad-initialization risk at added fit cost.
failure_modes: Selecting by withheld labels changes an unsupervised protocol into supervised selection.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Density radius
parameters.definition: Neighbourhood radius under the fitted feature geometry.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Neighbour if distance≤eps.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger radius connects more cases and can merge groups.
failure_modes: These numeric examples have no universal meaning across units/datasets.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Density minimum population
parameters.definition: Required neighbourhood population for a core point under a declared convention.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Core test counts neighbours, commonly including the point itself.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger minimum marks fewer points as core and may increase noise assignments.
failure_modes: Verify the backend's self-count and weight conventions.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Mixture covariance structure
parameters.definition: Which within-component feature dependencies are fitted.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Full uses a covariance matrix per component; diagonal omits cross-feature covariance.
parameters.expected_effect: More flexible forms estimate more quantities and require more evidence.
failure_modes: Singular covariance or tiny components need explicit diagnostics and stabilization.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: PCA components
parameters.definition: Retained linear directions of fitted training variance.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Projection dimension k≤min(training samples,feature dimension), with centring-rank caveats.
parameters.expected_effect: Fewer components compress more but can discard predictive low-variance signal.
failure_modes: Reject infeasible component counts rather than pad invented dimensions.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: PCA whitening
parameters.definition: Rescales retained component scores towards unit fitted variance.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Divides by fitted component scales under backend convention.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes downstream distance geometry and can amplify weak noisy directions.
failure_modes: Whitening is not ordinary input standardization and needs train-only fitted state.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Assumed anomaly fraction
parameters.definition: Assumption used to choose an anomaly decision threshold.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: A training-score quantile can define the flagged fraction.
parameters.expected_effect: Higher values can label more cases anomalous without improving the score model.
failure_modes: An assumed fraction is not verified prevalence or evidence of harm.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Forecast history lags
parameters.definition: Past offsets made available at each forecast origin.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Feature y_(origin−lag+1) under a documented lag convention.
parameters.expected_effect: Longer history can capture cycles and add missing boundaries/correlation.
failure_modes: Define indexing once; prevent target-time observations entering features.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Forecast horizon
parameters.definition: Steps from prediction origin to target.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Predict y_(origin+h).
parameters.expected_effect: Longer horizons change the task and available information, not just difficulty.
failure_modes: Do not compare different horizons in an unlabeled ranking.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Temporal evaluation gap
parameters.definition: Excluded time steps between training and evaluation boundaries.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Gap must follow feature/label overlap and availability requirements.
parameters.expected_effect: Can reduce boundary leakage but also removes training evidence.
failure_modes: No one gap value makes every time-series protocol valid.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Latent dimension
parameters.definition: Width of a compressed/learned representation.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: User/item score u·v or encoder output z has this many coordinates.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger width increases representational capacity and can weaken compression.
failure_modes: Similar latent widths across unrelated models do not imply equivalent complexity.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Epsilon-greedy exploration
parameters.definition: Probability of selecting a random allowed action.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Random action with probability epsilon; greedy action otherwise.
parameters.expected_effect: More exploration collects alternative feedback at potential immediate reward cost.
failure_modes: No live actions or deployment permission follows from this simulation setting.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Reward discount
parameters.definition: Relative weight given to later rewards.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Return=sum_k gamma^k reward_(t+k+1).
parameters.expected_effect: Larger gamma values value distant consequences and can increase estimation difficulty.
failure_modes: A contextual bandit has no multi-step transition return merely because it predicts rewards.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: GP kernel length scale
parameters.definition: Distance scale governing covariance decay.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: RBF k(x,z)=exp(−||x−z||²/(2 ell²)) for unit amplitude.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger ell encodes smoother long-range correlation.
failure_modes: A smooth uncertainty band is conditional on the chosen covariance assumptions.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: GP observation noise variance
parameters.definition: Declared diagonal observation-noise component.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Training covariance K+sigma_n² I.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger noise discounts observations more strongly under this model.
failure_modes: Observation-noise variance, numerical jitter and kernel amplitude are distinct quantities.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Configuration search budget
parameters.definition: Maximum evaluated configurations before a recipe is frozen.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Total fit count also multiplies folds/seeds/refits.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger budgets improve exploration at cost and increase selection opportunities.
failure_modes: Equal candidate counts do not equal equal compute; never rank by repeated test selection.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Hidden width
parameters.definition: Features/neurons in an intermediate dense representation.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Dense layer [d_in,d_out] has d_in×d_out weights plus optional biases.
parameters.expected_effect: Wider layers add capacity, activations and computation.
failure_modes: A wider model does not guarantee more useful features.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Hidden layers
parameters.definition: Number of nonlinear intermediate transformations, excluding the output head.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Composition h_l=activation(h_(l−1)W_l+b_l).
parameters.expected_effect: More depth changes compositional capacity and gradient paths.
failure_modes: Stacking only affine maps remains affine despite extra layers.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Activation function
parameters.definition: Nonlinear transformation between affine operations.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: ReLU(x)=max(0,x); other functions have different derivatives.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes expressivity, saturation and gradient dynamics.
failure_modes: Choose compatible initialization and inspect dead/saturated activations.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Optimizer learning rate
parameters.definition: Scale of the optimizer's parameter adjustment.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: SGD: w_new=w−eta g; adaptive optimizers transform g first.
parameters.expected_effect: Too small can learn slowly; too large can overshoot or diverge.
failure_modes: The same numeric rate is not a fair optimizer comparison without validation.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Gradient norm limit
parameters.definition: Optional maximum overall gradient norm at the declared update boundary.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: g←g×min(1,limit/||g||).
parameters.expected_effect: Limits very large updates without correcting the underlying objective.
failure_modes: Clip the intended accumulated/unscaled gradient, not an arbitrary intermediate one.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Optimizer
parameters.definition: Rule combining gradients and optional stored statistics into weight updates.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Different update rules use different state and decay conventions.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes convergence, memory and sensitivity to rates.
failure_modes: Do not equate adaptive weight decay with every L2 penalty recipe.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: SGD momentum
parameters.definition: Retention of previous gradient-driven velocity under a declared update convention.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: One convention: v_t=mu v_(t−1)+g_t; w←w−eta v_t.
parameters.expected_effect: Can smooth updates and accelerate directions while causing overshoot.
failure_modes: Different momentum conventions/initialization can produce different first updates.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Adam first-moment decay
parameters.definition: Retention rate in the moving mean gradient.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: m_t=beta1 m_(t−1)+(1−beta1)g_t, followed by bias correction.
parameters.expected_effect: Higher values average a longer history and react more slowly.
failure_modes: Do not omit bias correction when reproducing the declared Adam example.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Adam second-moment decay
parameters.definition: Retention rate in the moving squared gradient.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: v_t=beta2 v_(t−1)+(1−beta2)g_t², followed by bias correction.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes adaptation speed of denominator estimates.
failure_modes: Moment estimates are not a direct probability confidence interval.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Optimizer denominator stabilizer
parameters.definition: Small positive number in the adaptive update denominator.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: A common update divides m_hat by sqrt(v_hat)+epsilon.
parameters.expected_effect: Larger values can change updates where estimated gradient scales are tiny.
failure_modes: Some implementations place stabilizers differently; preserve the exact formula.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Weight initialization
parameters.definition: Starting distribution of trainable weight values.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Fan-in/out variance rules differ by activation and parametrization.
parameters.expected_effect: Affects signal/gradient scale before any learning.
failure_modes: Do not reset pretrained weights when the selected task is fine-tuning.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Activation normalization
parameters.definition: Rescales activation groups along specified axes.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: BatchNorm and LayerNorm use different statistics and axes.
parameters.expected_effect: Can change optimization and mode-dependent behaviour.
failure_modes: Not every layer/model supports interchangeable normalization without a structural change.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Decoupled weight decay
parameters.definition: Separate proportional shrinkage in the specified optimizer update.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: A simple stated component subtracts eta×lambda×w.
parameters.expected_effect: Restrains parameter scale but may underfit and depends on excluded tensors.
failure_modes: Do not silently claim this is identical to L2 regularization under Adam.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Learning-rate schedule
parameters.definition: Rule changing learning rate over declared progress units.
parameters.mathematical_meaning: Cosine example eta_t=eta_min+(eta_max−eta_min)(1+cos(pi t/T))/2.
parameters.expected_effect: Changes step size over a budget rather than model architecture.
failure_modes: Changing batch/accumulation can change the schedule unless units are preserved.
parameters.api_mapping: Confirm estimator/version/objective semantics in stage 2; no executable mapping exists yet.

parameters.label: Dropout probability
